fields.statement: Scratch build of the branch head in a fresh repo: add capability with 'Builds on @other (and [@other]) mail darin@hey.com checkout@v7 @@lit, prefix @<10-char ID prefix>' stored @{<full ID>} for @other, [@other] and the prefix, kept darin@hey.com and checkout@v7 as written, stored @@lit as @lit; show printed '@other ... @@lit'. A write of @@{<26-char ID>} is now refused (exit 2, 'a literal @{<full ID>} cannot be stored'), so the cycle-1 f2 hole is closed

Scratch build, fresh repo: @nosuch and @{BOGUS} refused with exit 4, code not_found naming each reference and field, next 'fix the handle, or write @@ for a literal @', nothing written, same with --dry-run and through rhiza apply (writes[1] named); a decision's quote kept '@nosuch' verbatim while its statement stored @{ID}; after retiring gone, set of holder with its shown @{<gone ID>} text kept it, while the same ID in another node or in holder's title was refused; note add 'ping @nosuch and @renamed' was written leniently and shown '@@nosuch and @renamed'; question answer 'Yes, per @nosuch and @renamed' stored the quote verbatim and the Decision statement with @{ID}, shown '@@nosuch and @renamed'

Scratch build, fresh repo: after set other --handle renamed, show, why, slice --json, search '@renamed', change show and change diff (text and --json), rhiza render's capability page and tui app show/why --once all printed @renamed; a retired node's reference showed as @{<full ID>} and writing that shown text back with set stored the same; a log entry hand-edited to 'legacy @word and @{ID}' showed '@@word and @@{ID}' and writing that back stored the same literal text

Scratch build: a hand-edited log entry holding @{01ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ} made rhiza check exit 1 with 'fail text-ref ... victim field statement holds @{01ZZ...}, which names no node'; a kept reference to a retired node gave a warn with check still ok; hand-written '@{ID}' gave nothing. On this repo at the branch head with a fresh cache, rhiza check reports no text-ref finding (cycle-1 f1 fixed); its only fails are stale rendered actor/index files from the verifiers' evidence commits, which the run's gate render regenerates
